## Research Purpose

::: {.card title="What does the project investigate?"}
The MSDM Culminating Experience Project for the **Tarkington Business Futures Institute (TBFI)** explores AI-assisted meta-analysis using **CALIPER**, with a focus on personalization in marketing communication.

The project aims to examine how AI can support evidence synthesis while retaining human review and traceable decisions.

**Research question:** How can an AI-assisted workflow support the extraction, organization, and review of evidence about personalization in marketing communication?
:::

::: {.card title="Evidence status"}
This is a **project overview dashboard**, not a completed results dashboard. The project dataset and verified analysis outputs have not yet been added to this portfolio.

No effect sizes, study counts, accuracy scores, or outcome claims are presented as measured findings.

Before reporting results, confirm the dataset version, inclusion criteria, coding definitions, and analysis outputs with the project team.
:::

## Planned Evidence Workflow

::: {.card title="From research evidence to audience insights"}
| Stage | Planned activity | Review output |
|---|---|---|
| Define | Specify the research question and eligibility rules | Documented scope |
| Prepare | Inspect source files, units, missing values, and duplicates | Data dictionary and audit notes |
| Extract | Use CALIPER to assist with structured coding | Traceable extracted fields |
| Verify | Compare extracted fields with source evidence | Reviewed coding and corrections |
| Analyze | Summarize eligible evidence with appropriate methods | Reproducible tables and charts |
| Communicate | Explain findings and limitations for TBFI | Audience-focused dashboard |

These are proposed workflow stages, not claims that each stage is finished.
:::

## Planned Results and Interpretation

::: {.card title="What will the results show?"}
Once the data are verified, this dashboard can show the number of included studies, distributions of coded characteristics, missing-data patterns, and findings from the agreed analysis.

If effect estimates and uncertainty measures are available, a forest plot may help communicate the evidence. Counts of coder-file rows must not be labeled as counts of unique studies without checking the unit of analysis.
:::

::: {.card title="How should the audience use the evidence?"}
Use the dashboard to understand the scope of the evidence, the review process, and the limits of any conclusions.

AI-assisted extraction requires human checking. Conclusions should reflect the included evidence and its uncertainty; they should not imply that personalization always improves marketing outcomes.
